target: Bangun tidur, dia langsung mengecek HP-nya.
english: As soon as he wakes up, he immediately checks his phone.
grammar: HP (say ha-pe) is the everyday word for phone; ponsel sounds formal. Mengecek HP = check the phone.

target: Jangan main HP terus waktu makan malam bersama keluarga.
english: Don't be on your phone the whole time during dinner with the family.

target: Saya lupa menaruh HP di mana, tolong telepon nomor saya.
english: I forgot where I put my phone, please call my number.

target: Sebelum rapat mulai, matikan dulu suara HP kalian.
english: Before the meeting starts, turn off your phones' sound first.

target: Setiap malam dia mengatur alarm di HP sebelum tidur.
english: Every night she sets the alarm on her phone before sleeping.

target: Layar HP saya retak karena jatuh dari meja.
english: My phone screen is cracked because it fell off the table.

target: Anak-anak sekarang lebih suka main HP daripada main di luar.
english: Kids these days prefer playing on their phones to playing outside.

target: HP baru itu kameranya bagus untuk foto keluarga.
english: That new phone's camera is good for family photos.

target: Waktu rapat penting, HP saya selalu dalam mode getar.
english: During important meetings, my phone is always on vibrate mode.

target: Dia mengganti nada dering HP-nya dengan lagu daerah.
english: He changed his phone's ringtone to a regional song.
grammar: Nada dering = ringtone, literally 'ring tone': mengganti nada dering = change the ringtone.

target: Mata saya sakit karena terlalu lama melihat layar HP.
english: My eyes hurt from looking at the phone screen for too long.

target: Ayah baru bisa memakai HP layar sentuh tahun lalu.
english: Dad only learned to use a touchscreen phone last year.

target: HP saya sudah lama, jadi sering lambat sekali.
english: My phone is old, so it's often very slow.
grammar: Colloquially a slow phone or connection is lemot: HP saya lemot = my phone is laggy.

target: Simpan nomor penting di HP dan juga di buku kecil.
english: Save important numbers on your phone and also in a small notebook.

target: Dia menjatuhkan HP-nya ke dalam air waktu mencuci baju.
english: She dropped her phone into the water while washing clothes.

target: Mbak, boleh minta password wifi-nya, ya?
english: Miss, could I have the wifi password, please?
grammar: The standard cafe question: minta password wifi-nya = may I have the wifi password.

target: Password wifi di kafe ini panjang sekali.
english: The wifi password at this cafe is really long.

target: Wifi di rumah mati sejak tadi pagi.
english: The wifi at home has been down since this morning.

target: Sinyal wifi di kamar belakang lemah, jadi saya pindah ke ruang tamu.
english: The wifi signal in the back room is weak, so I moved to the living room.

target: Hotel ini wifi-nya cepat, cocok untuk kerja dari kamar.
english: This hotel's wifi is fast, good for working from the room.

target: Coba matikan router sebentar, lalu nyalakan lagi.
english: Try turning off the router for a moment, then turn it on again.

target: Internet di kantor putus, jadi kami menunda rapat online sebentar.
english: The internet at the office is down, so we postponed the online meeting for a while.

target: Banyak orang datang ke kafe ini karena wifi-nya gratis.
english: Many people come to this cafe because the wifi is free.

target: Kalau wifi lambat, saya memakai data HP saja.
english: When the wifi is slow, I just use my phone data.

target: Adik saya marah karena password wifi diganti tanpa bilang-bilang.
english: My little brother is angry because the wifi password was changed without a word to anyone.

target: Tolong sambungkan laptop saya ke wifi ruang rapat.
english: Please connect my laptop to the meeting room wifi.

target: Wifi gratis di stasiun kadang tidak bisa dipakai.
english: The free wifi at the station sometimes can't be used.

target: Baterainya habis, saya harus ngecas HP dulu.
english: The battery is dead, I have to charge my phone first.
grammar: Ngecas (root cas) = to charge; colloquial but universal — all ages say ngecas HP.

target: Jangan lupa bawa charger kalau menginap di rumah nenek.
english: Don't forget to bring your charger when you stay over at grandma's house.

target: Boleh saya numpang ngecas HP di sini sebentar?
english: May I charge my phone here for a moment?
grammar: Numpang = politely use someone's facility: numpang ngecas = charge here, if I may.

target: HP saya dicas semalaman, tapi baterainya tetap cepat habis.
english: My phone was charged all night, but the battery still drains fast.
grammar: Di- + cas = passive: dicas semalaman = charged overnight. Semalaman = all night long.

target: Baterai HP ini awet, bisa dipakai seharian penuh.
english: This phone's battery lasts long; it can be used for a whole day.
grammar: Awet = long-lasting: baterainya awet = the battery lasts. Also used for food and clothes.

target: Saya selalu membawa powerbank kalau bepergian jauh.
english: I always bring a power bank when traveling far.
grammar: Powerbank is used as-is; bepergian = to travel, from pergi (to go).

target: Charger saya ketinggalan di kantor, jadi saya meminjam punya adik.
english: My charger got left behind at the office, so I borrowed my little sister's.

target: Kabel charger ini sudah rusak, saya harus membeli yang baru.
english: This charger cable is already broken; I have to buy a new one.

target: Baterai HP saya tinggal sepuluh persen, sebentar lagi mati.
english: My phone battery is down to ten percent; it will die soon.
grammar: Tinggal = remaining: tinggal sepuluh persen = only ten percent left.

target: Di bandara ada tempat ngecas HP dekat pintu keberangkatan.
english: At the airport there is a phone-charging spot near the departure gate.

target: Jangan main game sambil ngecas, nanti HP kamu cepat panas.
english: Don't play games while charging; your phone will heat up quickly.

target: Dia lupa mencabut charger dari colokan tadi pagi.
english: He forgot to unplug the charger from the outlet this morning.

target: Ibu selalu ngecas HP-nya di dapur setiap malam.
english: Mom always charges her phone in the kitchen every night.

target: Tablet adik mati karena baterainya habis, jadi dia menangis.
english: My little brother's tablet died because the battery ran out, so he cried.

target: Kalau baterai hampir habis, HP saya menjadi sangat lambat.
english: When the battery is almost empty, my phone becomes very slow.

target: Saya baru mengunduh aplikasi untuk belajar bahasa Indonesia.
english: I just downloaded an app for learning Indonesian.
grammar: Mengunduh = download; in speech people also just say download: download aplikasinya.

target: Aplikasi bank saya minta update sebelum bisa dibuka.
english: My banking app is asking for an update before it can be opened.

target: Memori HP penuh, jadi saya menghapus beberapa aplikasi lama.
english: The phone storage is full, so I deleted some old apps.

target: Tolong pasang aplikasi peta ini sebelum kita berangkat.
english: Please install this map app before we leave.

target: Aplikasi ini gratis, tapi banyak iklan yang mengganggu.
english: This app is free, but there are a lot of annoying ads.

target: Nenek belajar memakai aplikasi pesan supaya bisa membalas cucunya.
english: Grandma is learning to use a messaging app so she can reply to her grandchildren.

target: Saya memesan makan siang lewat aplikasi karena hujan deras.
english: I ordered lunch through an app because it was raining hard.

target: Semua tiket kereta kami beli lewat aplikasi di HP.
english: We bought all the train tickets through an app on the phone.

target: Aplikasi belanja itu sering memberi potongan harga besar.
english: That shopping app often gives big discounts.

target: Kakak memakai aplikasi untuk mencatat pengeluaran setiap bulan.
english: My older sister uses an app to record her expenses every month.
grammar: Pengeluaran = expenses/spending, from keluar (go out) — money going out.

target: Jangan mengunduh aplikasi dari luar toko resmi, itu berbahaya.
english: Don't download apps from outside the official store; that's dangerous.

target: Aplikasi ojek online ini bisa dipakai untuk mengirim barang.
english: This motorbike-taxi app can be used to send goods.

target: Setelah update, tampilan aplikasinya berubah total.
english: After the update, the app's interface changed completely.
grammar: Tampilan = the look/display: tampilannya berubah = the interface changed.

target: Saya mengatur bahasa aplikasi ini menjadi bahasa Indonesia.
english: I set this app's language to Indonesian.

target: Anak saya mengunduh game baru tanpa izin kemarin.
english: My kid downloaded a new game without permission yesterday.

target: Aplikasi kamera ini bisa membuat foto lama kelihatan baru.
english: This camera app can make old photos look new.

target: Kantor kami memakai aplikasi khusus untuk absen setiap pagi.
english: Our office uses a special app for clocking in every morning.
grammar: Absen in Indonesia = to mark attendance (clock in), not to be absent.

target: Saya memesan ojek online supaya tidak terlambat ke stasiun.
english: I ordered an online motorbike taxi so I would not be late to the station.

target: Naik ojol lebih cepat daripada naik mobil kalau jalanan macet.
english: Taking an ojol is faster than going by car when the roads are jammed.
grammar: Ojol = short for ojek online, the app-booked motorbike taxi everyone uses.

target: Drivernya sudah dekat, tolong tunggu di depan pintu.
english: The driver is close by; please wait in front of the door.
grammar: In ride-hailing the rider is just driver: drivernya sudah dekat = the driver is nearby.

target: Menurut aplikasi, drivernya masih lima menit lagi dari sini.
english: According to the app, the driver is still five minutes away from here.

target: Ongkos ojek online biasanya naik kalau hujan turun.
english: Online motorbike-taxi fares usually go up when it rains.

target: Jangan lupa memberi bintang lima kalau drivernya ramah.
english: Don't forget to give five stars if the driver is friendly.
grammar: Beri bintang lima = give five stars — the app rating; drivers really depend on it.

target: Saya salah menulis alamat, jadi drivernya menunggu di tempat lain.
english: I wrote the address wrong, so the driver waited at a different place.

target: Kirim lokasi kamu lewat aplikasi supaya drivernya tidak bingung.
english: Send your location through the app so the driver does not get confused.
grammar: Kirim lokasi (or share lokasi) = share your location — standard in chat and ride apps.

target: Menurut peta di HP, kita belok kiri di lampu merah kedua.
english: According to the map on the phone, we turn left at the second traffic light.

target: Tanpa aplikasi peta, saya pasti tersesat di kota sebesar ini.
english: Without a map app, I would definitely get lost in a city this big.
grammar: Ter- for accidents: tersesat = to get lost (not on purpose), from sesat.

target: Aplikasi peta bilang jalannya macet, lebih baik lewat jalan kecil.
english: The map app says the road is jammed; better to take the small streets.

target: Kami memesan dua ojol supaya sampai lebih cepat ke acara keluarga.
english: We booked two ojol so we would get to the family event faster.

target: Bapak itu bekerja sebagai driver ojek online sejak tahun lalu.
english: That man has been working as an online motorbike-taxi driver since last year.

target: Di aplikasi ada promo makanan setiap hari Jumat.
english: There is a food promo in the app every Friday.

target: Titik jemputnya di depan minimarket sebelah kantor pos.
english: The pickup point is in front of the minimart next to the post office.
grammar: Titik jemput = pickup point in ride apps; jemput = to pick someone up.

target: Saya membatalkan pesanan ojol karena drivernya tidak bergerak dari tadi.
english: I canceled the ojol order because the driver had not moved for a while.

target: Pesan lewat aplikasi saja, antre di loket panjang sekali.
english: Just order through the app; the line at the counter is really long.

target: Peta di HP saya salah, untung ada orang yang menunjukkan jalan.
english: The map on my phone was wrong; luckily someone showed me the way.

target: Setiap akhir pekan kami video call dengan nenek di kampung.
english: Every weekend we video-call grandma in the village.
grammar: Video call is used as-is, noun or verb: video call dengan nenek = video-call grandma.

target: Waktu video call, sinyal di rumah nenek sering putus-putus.
english: During video calls, the signal at grandma's house often keeps cutting out.
grammar: Putus-putus = keeps cutting out; putus alone = cut off, disconnected.

target: Anak-anak suka menunjukkan mainan baru mereka lewat video call.
english: The kids like showing their new toys over video call.

target: Ibu selalu menangis sedikit setiap video call dengan kakak di luar negeri.
english: Mom always cries a little every video call with my older brother abroad.

target: Kami melakukan video call dengan tim Jakarta setiap Senin pagi.
english: We have a video call with the Jakarta team every Monday morning.

target: Suara kamu putus-putus, coba matikan dulu kameranya.
english: Your voice keeps cutting out; try turning off your camera first.

target: Kakek belum tahu cara menerima video call dari cucunya.
english: Grandpa does not know yet how to answer a video call from his grandchildren.

target: Sebelum video call kerja, saya selalu merapikan meja dulu.
english: Before a work video call, I always tidy my desk first.

target: Video call keluarga besar kemarin ramai sekali, semua bicara bersama.
english: Yesterday's extended-family video call was really lively; everyone talked at once.

target: Kalau rindu rumah, saya langsung video call ibu di dapur.
english: When I miss home, I immediately video-call Mom in the kitchen.

target: Layar HP terlalu kecil, jadi kami memakai laptop untuk video call bersama.
english: The phone screen is too small, so we use the laptop to video-call together.

target: Dia lupa mematikan mikrofon waktu rapat online tadi pagi.
english: He forgot to turn off his microphone during the online meeting this morning.
grammar: Mematikan = turn off, menyalakan = turn on — from mati (dead) and nyala (lit).

target: Memori HP saya penuh karena terlalu banyak foto dan video.
english: My phone storage is full because of too many photos and videos.
grammar: Memori penuh = storage full — the standard phone complaint; memori = phone storage.

target: Saya menghapus video lama supaya ada tempat untuk foto baru.
english: I deleted old videos so there is room for new photos.

target: Foto-foto liburan kami tersimpan di HP dan juga di laptop.
english: Our vacation photos are stored on the phone and also on the laptop.
grammar: Ter- + simpan = stative: tersimpan = (safely) stored, with no one doing the storing.

target: Jangan hapus foto itu, itu satu-satunya foto kakek waktu muda.
english: Don't delete that photo; it's the only photo of grandpa when he was young.

target: Video ulang tahun anak saya terlalu besar untuk dikirim.
english: My child's birthday video is too big to send.

target: HP-nya sering mati sendiri karena memorinya hampir penuh.
english: The phone often shuts off by itself because its storage is almost full.

target: Saya memindahkan semua foto lama ke laptop di rumah.
english: I moved all the old photos to the laptop at home.

target: Setelah memorinya dibersihkan, HP saya menjadi cepat lagi.
english: After its storage was cleaned out, my phone became fast again.

target: Grup keluarga kami penuh ucapan selamat setiap ada yang ulang tahun.
english: Our family group chat is full of congratulations whenever someone has a birthday.

target: Saya mematikan notifikasi grup kantor setiap akhir pekan.
english: I turn off the office group notifications every weekend.
grammar: To mute a chat: matikan notifikasi grupnya = turn off the group's notifications.

target: Pesan di grup RT pagi ini penting, tolong dibaca.
english: The message in the neighborhood group this morning is important; please read it.
grammar: RT (rukun tetangga) = your neighborhood block; nearly every RT has its own grup.

target: Om dan tante paling rajin mengirim gambar selamat pagi di grup.
english: Uncles and aunts are the most diligent at sending good-morning images in the group.
grammar: Gambar selamat pagi — the flowery good-morning images older relatives send daily.

target: Jangan membahas politik di grup keluarga, nanti semua bertengkar.
english: Don't discuss politics in the family group, or everyone will end up fighting.

target: Ada dua ratus pesan baru di grup kantor setelah saya rapat dua jam.
english: There were two hundred new messages in the office group after my two-hour meeting.

target: Dia keluar dari grup itu karena terlalu banyak pesan tidak penting.
english: She left that group because there were too many unimportant messages.

target: Berita di grup itu belum tentu benar, cek dulu sebelum percaya.
english: News in that group is not necessarily true; check first before believing it.
grammar: Belum tentu = not necessarily: belum tentu benar = not necessarily true.

target: Tante saya sering percaya hoaks yang dikirim ke grup keluarga.
english: My aunt often believes the hoaxes sent to the family group.
grammar: Hoaks = hoax/fake news — an everyday Indonesian word for group-chat misinformation.

target: Tolong balas di grup supaya semua orang tahu jadwalnya.
english: Please reply in the group so everyone knows the schedule.

target: Stiker lucu itu dikirim adik saya ke semua grup.
english: That funny sticker was sent by my little sister to all the groups.
grammar: Passive di- + agent, no 'oleh' needed: dikirim adik saya = sent by my little sister.

target: Kami membuat grup baru khusus untuk acara pernikahan kakak.
english: We made a new group just for my older sister's wedding.

target: Jangan kirim foto itu ke grup besar, kirim ke saya saja.
english: Don't send that photo to the big group; just send it to me.

target: Pengumuman rapat besok sudah dikirim di grup kantor sore tadi.
english: The announcement for tomorrow's meeting was sent in the office group this afternoon.

target: Kirim foto KTP kamu lewat pesan, nanti saya daftarkan.
english: Send a photo of your ID card by message, and I'll register you.
grammar: KTP = the Indonesian ID card; kirim foto KTP is a routine request.

target: Foto yang kamu kirim semalam tidak bisa dibuka di HP saya.
english: The photo you sent last night won't open on my phone.

target: Lokasi restorannya saya kirim lewat pesan, ya.
english: I'll send the restaurant's location by message, okay?
grammar: Object first + saya kirim = everyday passive: lokasinya saya kirim = I'll send the location.

target: Paket data saya habis sebelum akhir bulan lagi.
english: My data plan ran out before the end of the month again.
grammar: Paket data = mobile data plan; kuota = your data allowance for the month.

target: Kuota internet cepat habis kalau sering menonton video.
english: Internet data runs out fast if you watch videos a lot.

target: Sinyal di kampung halaman saya sekarang sudah kuat.
english: The signal in my hometown is strong now.
grammar: Kampung halaman = hometown, where your family is from — not just any kampung.

target: Dia membagikan foto pemandangan itu ke media sosial.
english: She shared that scenery photo to social media.

target: Jangan menaruh nomor HP di media sosial, itu tidak aman.
english: Don't put your phone number on social media; it's not safe.

target: Saya lupa password email lama, jadi membuat akun baru.
english: I forgot my old email password, so I made a new account.
grammar: Password is the everyday word; kata sandi is what formal screens call it.

target: Belanja online memang mudah, tapi hati-hati dengan toko palsu.
english: Online shopping really is easy, but be careful with fake stores.

target: Barang yang saya beli online sampai dalam dua hari.
english: The item I bought online arrived within two days.

target: Kami menonton film lewat aplikasi karena bioskop jauh dari rumah.
english: We watch movies through an app because the cinema is far from home.

target: Internet di sini lambat, mengunggah video saja butuh satu jam.
english: The internet here is slow; just uploading a video takes an hour.
grammar: Mengunggah = upload, mengunduh = download; upload and download are also said as-is.

target: Anak muda sekarang lebih sering mengetik daripada menulis dengan tangan.
english: Young people now type more often than they write by hand.
